name: focal-point-picker

frames.best_why: Banner crop highlighted with its frame drawn across the photo and the crosshair at the chosen point.

tagline: Drag a crosshair over a photo and its crops reframe as you move.
summary: A control for setting an image's focal point. Moving the crosshair on the photo re-crops three preview shapes live: a square avatar, a wide banner and a tall story.
appearance: A dark rounded card holds a large mountain photo above a row of three crop previews. The photo carries a fine white crosshair with an orange centre dot, and a caption line under it shows a percentage pair on the right. The previews are labelled Avatar, Banner and Story.
behaviour: Dragging on the photo moves the crosshair and every preview reframes at once; a click glides the point instead. Hovering a crop dims the photo outside that crop's window and outlines where it will cut.
demo_content: A snowy mountain range above a valley of clouds, with previews labelled Avatar, Banner and Story.
search_phrases: set focal point on an image
choose crop position for a photo
drag a point to centre a picture
use_when: A product stores one image in several shapes and someone must choose a point that works for all of them.
avoid_when: The default photo loads from a remote Unsplash URL, so the demo needs network unless you pass your own source.
customise: Photo, alt text, aspect ratio, default point and crop list are props; the three default shapes and the card styling are edited in the source.
weight_why: One large image and three small previews with pointer handlers; no animation loop.

a11y.note: Arrow keys move the point and the button states its coordinates; crop previews carry only their shape visually and no reduced-motion check exists.

props.name: alt
props.default: Peaks above a sea of clouds

issues: Default photo is fetched from Unsplash, so the card is empty without a network connection.
polish_why: Thoughtful crosshair, live crop previews, keyboard support and a clean, complete card.
